title: Behind the scenes of Spotify’s annual Gen Z report
discussion_signal: The discussion presents Gen Z audio culture through fandoms, life-stage rituals, video podcasts, genre discovery, and cross-format participation, treating listening as a way to build identity and belonging.
linked_research_question: How is Gen Z audio culture organized through fandom, life-stage rituals, cross-format participation, and identity practices that turn listening into belonging?
limits: The post is connected to Spotify’s commercial culture report
It does not represent all Gen Z listeners or non-Spotify behaviour
Fandom and engagement signals do not establish broader social belonging outcomes
